plan.product: CODE rapid, unchanged September 5 admitted RF and reference products
plan.selection: all 22 declared references, all seven stations, all 61 second-half epochs; no replacements
plan.training: all first-half epochs, pseudo-target excluded from every receiver-clock calibration and offset fit
plan.coefficient_gauge: zero mean over training reference coefficients; pseudo-target coefficient never estimated or applied
plan.scope: Exploratory differential RF diagnostic with known reference states. Not independent positioning, population coverage or absolute-error qualification. Common modes remain unidentifiable.
plan.stopping: Keep missing observations, insufficient remaining references, rank/support failures and numerical failures. No target G12 observations or orbit. No promotion or floor reduction.

baseline_plan.scope: Exploratory distinct-day local chronological contrast prediction. Five shared stations, two changed; different excluded target and reference allowlist. Not isolated day causality, cross-day coefficient transfer, absolute future RF, new confirmation or covariance qualification.
baseline_plan.stopping_rule: One fixed hour and full declared cohort; retain failures and unsupported predictions, no station or time replacements.

scope: Exposed reference-only differential RF diagnostic. Pseudo-target absent from clock/offset calibration; its known state is used to evaluate residuals. Not independent positioning.
